routes.description: The document, the home page listing every Showcase, the offline page the service worker falls back to, and each Showcase's thin routes

app-shell-showcase.description: The App Shell Showcase: a small workspace in ui-toolkit's App Shell, its sidebar, header and account menu each turned on or off by Tweaks

gestures-showcase.description: The Gestures Showcase: what use-gesture can do, one Topic per page, each a set of Scenarios with a live demo and its code

features-showcase.description: The Features Showcase: end-to-end apps where several gestures meet on one screen, such as a mail inbox

keyboard-showcase.description: The Keyboard Showcase: a notes app run from the keyboard, its Surfaces and Actions in one definition, with a palette, a list of every key, and settings to record new ones

common.description: What every Showcase shares: the theme the document boots with, Tweaks (how a Showcase declares its settings, saves them and shows them), and the dialog that shows its code

kstack.description: The router over the routes; the routes over the Showcases; each Showcase is self-contained and shares only common
